title: Foxglove & Company — rebrand pitch for Saltwater Coffee
audience: client exec team evaluating 3 agencies for a rebrand engagement
core_points: The hook: Saltwater's current brand is polite but forgettable; your baristas already embody the soul
What we heard: customers love the mornings but don't remember the logo
Our thesis: lean into the coast — tide, fog, ferry light — not generic minimalism
Competitive landscape: Blue Bottle owns precision, Verve owns technical, nobody owns coastal-romantic
Visual territory: mist, cool blues, aged brass, hand-drawn marks — not another matte black wordmark
Naming system: keep Saltwater, add regional sub-brands (Saltwater Ferry / Headlands / Pier 41)
Packaging samples: cup sleeves that double as bookmarks, bags with tide-chart printing
Digital: website that ripples, weekly 'tide report' tasting notes, Instagram that changes with weather
Story-first rollout plan: local before national, 4 flagship stores first, soft website relaunch
Timeline and pricing: 16 weeks, phased delivery, 3 milestone payments totaling $340K
Why us: we do 6 rebrands a year, only 2 of them are coffee, we say no to safe
